REJECTED: Closed by a maintainer without a fix: declined, invalid or out of scope.
ABANDONED/NEEDS_INFO: Closed because more information was needed or it could not be reproduced. Not fixed.
ABANDONED/STALE: Closed after a period of inactivity. Not fixed, and no maintainer decided against it.
ABANDONED/bot-closed (V2): Closed automatically by a bot. Not fixed, and no maintainer decided against it.
ABANDONED/OTHER: Closed without a fix. The reason is not recorded.
REDIRECTED: Closed as a duplicate. It is tracked in another issue.
